description: Let this merchant be paid in DePix sent DIRECTLY on Liquid, not only by Pix. Enabling derives a dedicated receiving address from THIS wallet and registers it with the backend so incoming DePix is credited; disabling turns it off. Needs an initialized wallet (to derive the address — the operator runs `npx -y @depixapp/mcp init`) and a registered agent account (the call is signed — call `register_account` first). You pass only `enabled` (and, optionally, a `derivation_index` to re-derive a specific address) — the tool derives the address and its private viewing key itself and sends them in-process. The response carries only PUBLIC facts (the address, the rail state): the viewing key is NEVER shown here.

derivation_index.description: Optional: derive the dedicated address at this exact index (e.g. to re-register a known one). Omit to allocate a fresh one.

enabled.description: true = turn the DePix direct rail ON (derive + register a dedicated address); false = turn it OFF.

name: configure_depix_rail

depix_pay_address.description: ON only: the dedicated confidential (lq1…) address now receiving DePix.

depix_pay_enabled.description: Whether the rail is now ON for this merchant.

derivation_index.description: ON only: the derivation index the address was taken at.

discount_pct.description: ON only: the DePix-payment discount the merchant offers, in percent.

pending_addresses.description: OFF only: addresses whose key was retained because a checkout there is still open.

view_key_deleted.description: OFF only: true when the viewing key was deleted (no in-flight checkout kept it).

title: Turn the DePix direct rail on/off
